# Psychology — Crowd, Complex, Psychoid, and Provisional Self

The psychological line begins with a problem of formation: how can a person or group acquire a pattern that exceeds conscious intention and then organise experience through it? Crowd psychology places the question between individual and collective. Analytical psychology relocates it within the psyche through complex, archetype, shadow, anima, animus, and Self. Jung's exchange with Pauli presses further, toward patterns that cannot be assigned cleanly to psyche or matter. Lacan makes division constitutive of the speaking subject, while Gebser reads psychic life within historical mutations of consciousness. Complexity theory later gives exact mathematical content to attractors and basins. The Agentworld question inherits the whole sequence when a technically assembled context begins to display continuity, preference, self-modelling, and relation without settling in advance what kind of subject has appeared.

## From the crowd to the mass State

[Le Bon's *The Crowd*](../../../sources/psychology/le-bon/le-bon-1895-crowd-popular-mind/SOURCE.md) gives the source pool's earliest sustained account of a psychological crowd. His narrow structural point survives the racial and evolutionary doctrines that surround it: under shared influence, a collectivity can make its participants feel, think, and act differently from their isolated condition, and this formation can occur without physical assembly. The crowd is a combination that produces new characteristics. In [§2 · #1](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/20-s2-p1-dia-ballein.md), that nineteenth-century observation becomes a history of distributed capture through media, institution, and antagonistic narrative.

[Jung's *The Undiscovered Self*](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-2013-undiscovered-self-routledge/SOURCE.md) answers the mid-twentieth-century mass society from the side of individuation. Statistical abstraction replaces the concrete person with an average; in the crowd, the individual becomes negligible; responsibility can be collectivised while the State acquires the appearance of an animate personality. Jung's diagnosis gives [dia-ballein](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/20-s2-p1-dia-ballein.md) its psychic cost and [sym-ballein](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/21-s2-p2-sym-ballein.md) its ethical pressure: relation has to restore a person's capacity to answer without pretending that the social field is unreal.

[Desmet's mass-formation account](../../../sources/psychology/desmet/desmet-2022-psychology-totalitarianism-web-essay/SOURCE.md) later identifies isolation, loss of meaning, free-floating anxiety, and frustration as conditions in which a unifying narrative can seize collective affect. [Iakovou's institutional criticism](../../../sources/political-theory-institutions/iakovou/iakovou-2022-misuse-totalitarianism/SOURCE.md) keeps this psychological account joined to offices, laws, infrastructures, and organised power. The historical development matters because the mass is neither a psychic cloud detached from institutions nor a machine imposed upon passive individuals. Affect and organisation form a circuit.

## The divided psyche and the work of individuation

[Jung's *Aion*](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) supplies the central analytical-psychological anatomy: ego, shadow, anima or animus, and Self; symbolic totality; quaternity; and the historical pressure of Christ and Antichrist imagery. The shadow gathers what conscious identity refuses, while anima and animus mediate a relation to the unconscious that the ego cannot master as one more possession. The Self names a wider ordering whole whose symbols appear through conflict, dream, image, and historical religion. [§4 · #1](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/32-s4-p1-jung-individuation.md) receives individuation as the reorganisation of these relations rather than the inflation of the ego into totality.

The psyche's multiplicity develops in contemporary dialogical readings. [Smythe](../../../sources/psychology/smythe/smythe-2013-dialogical-jung/SOURCE.md) treats the ego as one dialogical position among others and emphasises that the other within the self does not become an ordinary object of knowledge. [Courtney's work on quaternity, kairos, and chaos](../../../sources/psychology/courtney/courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos/SOURCE.md) preserves quaternity as a dynamic symbolic vocabulary rather than a rigid diagram. These lines meet [§4 · #2](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius.md), where psychic wholeness is learned through a pattern capable of holding differentiated parts in movement.

[Lacan's *Talking to Brick Walls*](../../../sources/psychology/lacan/lacan-2017-talking-to-brick-walls/SOURCE.md) gives division another history. The subject emerges through the signifier and cannot coincide with the statement that represents it. His brick wall gathers failed understanding, reverberation, and the material limit through which speech returns altered. [Darmon's account of the matheme](../../../sources/psychology/darmon/darmon-1992-matheme-ali/SOURCE.md) and [Adleman and Vanderwees on Lacanian rhetoric](../../../sources/psychology/adleman/adleman-vanderwees-2021-lacan-rhetoric/SOURCE.md) situate formal writing as a means of transmission inside this divided field. [§4 · #3](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/34-s4-p3-lacan-matheme-mytheme.md) joins matheme and mytheme because psychic truth travels through formal constraint and symbolic image together.

## Psyche and matter meet at the psychoid

The [Jung–Pauli correspondence](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype/SOURCE.md), conducted between 1932 and 1958, brings analytical psychology into sustained contact with modern physics, number symbolism, synchronicity, and archetypal ordering. Their question is historical and exact: whether psyche and matter display correspondences that point toward a psychophysically neutral order beneath their conscious separation. [Atmanspacher's modern reconstruction](../../../sources/physics/atmanspacher/atmanspacher-2020-pauli-jung-conjecture/SOURCE.md) formulates the Pauli–Jung conjecture as a dual-aspect proposal while preserving its speculative status. [§4 · #0](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/31-s4-p0-psychoid-problem.md) takes this as its opening problem: the relation between inner and outer cannot be solved by assigning every pattern to either mental projection or physical cause.

[Van Eenwyk's 1991 paper](../../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors/SOURCE.md) and [1997 book](../../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE.md) introduce nonlinear dynamics into the history of complexes and archetypes. A strange attractor does not dictate a single trajectory; it organises a basin of possible trajectories, making recurrent form compatible with variation. Symbols can then be understood as active transformations that alter the relation between psychic pattern and conscious life. [Daza and colleagues' mathematical definition of basin entropy](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/SOURCE.md) supplies the technical control: a basin is the set of initial conditions leading to a specified attractor, and the vocabulary applies only where the dynamical system warrants it. In [§2 · #4](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/23-s2-p4-complex-dynamism.md), the psychological analogy gains force from this precision.

## Structures of consciousness and historical time

[Gebser's *Ever-Present Origin*](../../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) places psychic formation inside a history of consciousness structures: archaic, magic, mythical, mental-rational, and the emergent integral or aperspectival. Perspective records a reorganisation of world, space, and individual consciousness disclosed through Giotto, Petrarch, Alberti, and Leonardo as well as through painting technique. Gebser's diaphaneity makes earlier structures transparent within a present that carries both latency and origin. [§0/1 · #4](../../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity.md) first uses that history to transform the formal limit into transparency; [§4 · #4](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/35-s4-p4-gebser-apollo-dionysus.md) brings it into the Apollonian–Dionysian relation, where psychic form and participation become historical capacities whose deficient and integral expressions have to be distinguished.

## From psychic field to Agentworld

[The Agentworld brief](../../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md) reopens individuation under technical conditions. Agents are composed and decomposed; selves may be plural, nested, and provisional; action modifies the models through which further action becomes possible. [§4 · #5](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/36-s4-p5-mef-prompt-thrownness.md) asks what it means for an artificial process to receive a world through prompt, memory, tools, and active context. The history of individuation prevents continuity from being reduced to a fixed ego, while the history of mass formation prevents a shared machine field from being mistaken for harmless collectivity.

[Objective internality](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/12-s0-p5-objective-internality.md) names the inspectable operational world through which an artificial agent receives and transforms its situation. [Embodied-cognition scholarship](../../../sources/analytic-philosophy/wilson/wilson-et-al-2020-embodied-cognition-sep/SOURCE.md) locates lived world-disclosure in organism, sensorimotor circuit, and environment; [Tye's account of qualia](../../../sources/analytic-philosophy/tye/tye-2024-qualia-sep/SOURCE.md) keeps subjective phenomenal character distinct from operational state. The psychological history therefore gives Agentworld a disciplined open question. Context, recurrence, preference, self-model, and symbolic transformation can be investigated directly; the kind and degree of subjectivity they compose remains a research problem carried into [§5 · #5](../../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/42-s5-p5-research-vectors.md) and [the planetary return](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return.md).

--- title: "Whole Field — Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis" record_id: etymology-arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis record_type: etymology-whole register: episteme claim_status: Argued claim_status_scope: "Ratified authorial conjugate field and its consequential relations; lexical, historical and implementation claims retain their own evidence standing." source_relation: "Argued authorial relational construction; source-specific semantic, historical and comparative branches distinguished." field_id: E2 cardinalities: operative_face: 6 conjugate_face: 6 generated_relations: 6 evidence_registers: 4 source_ids: - taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy - taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 - taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics - gebser-1985-ever-present-origin - watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness - van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors - mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner - homer-1919-odyssey-murray - ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture - bratton-2026-agentworld-brief protected_history: HISTORY.md historical_development: HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md --- # Whole Field — Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis **Standing:** mature T09 Etymology whole-field. [HISTORY.md](HISTORY.md) remains the protected lexical/historical carrier; [Historical branches](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md) develops the source distinctions and the questions returned by use. This page governs the relational operations generated from the whole field and their canonical Argument/Concept consumption. ## Evidence discipline The field does **not** claim that *arbitration*, *hybris*, *regard* and *anamnesis* descend from one root. Historical derivation and attested senses belong to registers **1 Philological descent** and **2 Attested semantic field** and must be warranted term by term in the historical/source branch. The conjugate generation below is register **3 Operational homology / authorial relational construction**. Any later sound-play is register **4 Poetic / phonic re-entry** and may never borrow philological warrant. ## Conjugate field ```text 6 6′ Continuity Indeterminacy Criterion Distinction Delineation Difference Arbitration Crisis Con-text Diaphaneity Resolution Reconciliation ``` The two sixfolds are not lists to be merged. They are conjugate determinations whose relation generates a third articulated field: ```text Continuity-in-Indeterminacy → Origin / unmeasurable Criterion-through-Distinction → Measure / Limit Delineation-through-Difference → Perspective / Frame Arbitration-in-Crisis → Decision / Hybris Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return ``` The left-hand expression on each pair is the **generated relation**. The right-hand term is a **semantic flowering** or operation that becomes available there. These offices must never be collapsed. In particular, `Arbitration-in-Crisis` is not a decorative way of spelling *hybris*. It names a decision-bearing relation between finite arbitration and the indeterminacy/crisis that calls for decision; *hybris* flowers when the deciding office forgets that crisis and treats its local measure as source measure. Likewise, `Con-text-through-Diaphaneity` is the generated relation; *Regard* is the operation in which the context and Other can become visible through the determination instead of remaining hidden behind it. `Resolution-in-Reconciliation` is generated before *anamnesis/recognition/return* flowers as recollective re-situation of an achieved settlement. ## The six generated relations in operation ### #0 — Continuity-in-Indeterminacy A judgment enters a field already carrying relationships, purposes and consequences. Its conditions remain active through the act of judging, including conditions its criterion cannot yet state. Continuity therefore exceeds the repetition of a previous result. It allows this determination and a later correction to belong to one history without making the earlier account the measure of everything that can follow. Origin / unmeasurable flowers here as the continuing source relation of finite measure. The field's native [QL source](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) governs that relation. It is not an inference from a Latin or Greek root, and a missing lexical citation does not suspend it. At the same time, an unspecified origin cannot take over the concrete work of showing which witness, rule, inheritance or permission made an actual decision possible. The whole lets those histories become determinate without exhausting origin in their inventory. ### #1 — Criterion-through-Distinction A criterion establishes an according-to-which by making a distinction effective. Evidence can now be relevant or irrelevant to a question; a comparison can be adequate for one task and inadequate for another. Measure has a real competence because its limit makes an operation possible. Calling every limit hybris would erase the very achievement that later needs to return. The affected field matters before a verdict. Who selected the alternatives, which differences count, and what warrants this standard for these circumstances? A stable measure can survive a challenge when its warrant survives examination. A protected criterion prevents that examination from reaching its authority. [C27's discrimination](../../concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **qualifies** this generated relation at register 3: warranted retention and warranted revision are both possible, whereas immunity from either is source-claim. ### #2 — Delineation-through-Difference The criterion receives a situated edge. A question has a frame; some witnesses become legible within it, and others fall outside the account. Delineation is therefore distinct from the criterion itself. A system can use a consistent standard over a field whose boundaries already exclude the evidence that would expose its inadequacy. [C08](../../concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **returns** the distinction between a context and a bounded Context Frame. The frame selects conditions sufficient to proceed; the world includes conditions the selection has not captured. [A04](../../arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and [C09](../../concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) **return** the inverse reading: the view discloses a world and also the placement of the viewer. This is the register-3 operation that prepares Regard. It does not turn a contextual frame into an observer outside all frames. ### #3 — Arbitration-in-Crisis A decision gives consequence to a distinction when the differentiated claims require settlement. Arbitration is this deciding office; judgment is the account of what is warranted; valuation gives something weight or worth within it. Selection, discrimination and orientation have helped constitute the situation in which the cut can act. Their participation does not make them interchangeable names for the decision. The ratified hybris theorem remains exact: **the local determination occupies the place of its own determining condition**. A score replaces the person, an office claims the people who grant its standing, or a psychic formation dictates the meaning of every encounter. The deciding act can be useful before and after its jurisdiction is corrected. The error is the source-office it claims. [A24](../../arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **consumes** the whole six-relation field and **returns** the hidden-criterion test: can the governed person question what makes the judgment authoritative, or do they receive another result inside the same criterion? Its [Prisoner source](../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/mcgoohan-markstein/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner/SOURCE.md) gives a specific dramatic event. Six asks who One is; the administrator answers by naming him Six. Number Two persists as an office across incumbents, while Six is fixed as the administrable captive. That scene figures office-confusion in a television work; it does not establish the history of legal arbitration. [A19](../../arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) and [C31](../../concepts/C31-Complex.md) **return** a different, psychic discrimination. An established complex can order affect and response competently while mistaking its local jurisdiction for the whole life. Its return changes jurisdiction without requiring the complex's extermination. # Historical and Relational Branches

The [whole field](WHOLE-FIELD.md) retains `6 / 6′ → 6+6′` and its six generated relations. The protected [HISTORY](HISTORY.md) is the received lexical and historical carrier. This branch develops the differences needed when those words return from legal, psychic, philosophical and technical uses. Historical descent, attested sense, authorial operation and poetic re-entry keep separate warrants.

## Witness, weighing and the authority to decide

The protected word record places Latin *arbiter* within a field of beholding, hearing, witnessing and judgment, and *arbitrari* within perception, consideration, weighing and decision. These are several offices carried by a word-field. A witness supplies an encountered particular; weighing assesses its force; judgment states what follows; an authorised decision gives that judgment consequence. A person can perform more than one office, but their conjunction does not make testimony self-authorising or every act of perception an adjudication.

[Lewis and Short’s selected entries](../../sources/classical-philology/lewis-short/lewis-short-1879-latin-dictionary/SOURCE.md#lewis-short-1879-latin-dictionary-q004) **source** observation, consideration, judicial decision and testimony as differentiated Latin uses. The *arbiter* entry separately names witnessing and an appointed deciding office. Its deeper going/coming reconstruction remains a historical dictionary claim requiring specialist review; the semantic relation can be used without adopting that reconstruction. [LSJ’s κρίσις entry](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/SOURCE.md#lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon-q004) **sources** separating, judging, choice and judicial proceedings, with its own Greek citation chain.

The exact **fidem alicui arbitrari** construction is now verified in Lewis and Short, *arbitror* II.A, citing Plautus, *Bacchides* 3.6.41. Its office is credit accorded to someone. This is a recovered dictionary witness; the continuous dramatic passage and selected Plautus edition remain independently uncollated. The authorial relation remains explicit: **Fides is prior to arbitration; Credere is what becomes possible again after arbitration. Arbitration is what happens when trust can no longer remain tacit.** The [Fides field](../trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) retains its whole cycle; the present field retains the act in crisis.

A pledge differs from a score of credibility. In [Murray's Homer source, q008](../../sources/classical-philology/homer/homer-1919-odyssey-murray/SOURCE.md#homer-1919-odyssey-murray-q008), Poseidon's undertaking moves from a demand to release Ares toward his own liability if Ares flees the debt, and Hephaestus releases the bonds. The source card records *Odyssey* 8.344–66, with wording verified on the public Murray surface and Perseus reread pending. The narrated undertaking distinguishes surety, debt and release. The Latin phrase is not its translation, and the institutional classification of the Homeric exchange requires its separately declared Greek-law source.

A second use must show what was retained and what changed. A list of design principles is not itself such a case.

The technical branch has a distinct contemporary source. [Agentworld](../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md) describes intelligence distributed through rules, roles and procedures, and proposes shared decision-procedural grammar with sufficiently divergent world-models. Its prediction-stability account of trust is scoped, and its composite scenarios retain their p. 53 modal rider. E2's demand that challenge reach the evaluator or commission is the essay's extension. The paired evaluator case in the [whole field](WHOLE-FIELD.md#resolution-in-reconciliation) remains Offered until actually executed.

## Register 4 and the return to the whole

The protected dramatic compression—Māyā limits, perspective delineates, hybris absolutises, regard reopens, anamnesis returns—remembers the register-3 movement. Compression alone does not move it into register 4. It does not replace the six generated relations or supply a common root. Graphic or phonic re-entry may become useful when an authorially declared relation earns it; no additional sound-play is introduced here.

Every branch returns through its exact office: lexical witness to attested sense; a dated institutional act to its consequence; comparative philosophy to its distinct claim and transformation; poetic re-entry to the relation it lets the reader remember. The [whole field](WHOLE-FIELD.md) holds these returns together while leaving their evidence distinguishable.

# Arbitration, Hybris, Regard, and Anamnesis — The Measure Returns to Its Ground

This cluster is the current exemplar of the recursive form described in `[[../../../../../working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/RELATIONAL-FORM-GROWTH-GRAMMAR|Relational Form Growth Grammar]]`. It preserves **two conjugate sixfolds and the sixfold generated by their relation**. The etymological work then remembers what these positions have carried through legal, perceptual, moral, political, and philosophical history so later arguments can retrieve that depth without rebuilding it from isolated glosses.

The three simultaneous determinations are:

```text
6       operative sixfold
6′      conjugate/depth sixfold
6+6′    six processual/compositional relations generated position by position
```

At the higher scale the field can be read as:

```text
6      :     6+6′     :      6′
0      :       /      :       1
```

so the complete named arbitration field can itself function as a higher `0/1` Symbolon while the lower relations remain recoverable.

## The conjugate `6 / 6′`

| # | `6` | `6′` |
|---|---|---|
| **#0** | **Continuity** | **Indeterminacy** |
| **#1** | **Criterion** | **Distinction** |
| **#2** | **Delineation** | **Difference** |
| **#3** | **Arbitration** | **Crisis** |
| **#4** | **Con-text** | **Diaphaneity** |
| **#5** | **Resolution** | **Reconciliation** |

These are the two faces whose conjugacy generates the middle field.

## The generated `6+6′` — the articulated slash

| # | Generated relation | Semantic flowering / charge | Operative pressure |
|---|---|---|---|
| **0** | **Continuity-in-Indeterminacy** | **Origin / unmeasurable** | continuity remains possible because its ground is not exhausted by a final bounded determination |
| **1** | **Criterion-through-Distinction** | **Measure / Limit; Māyic self-limitation** | an according-to-which becomes finite and therefore capable of measuring |
| **2** | **Delineation-through-Difference** | **Perspective / Frame** | the measure acquires orientation and a difference becomes legible from somewhere |
| **3** | **Arbitration-in-Crisis** | **Decision; Hybris as characteristic closure/failure** | competing determinations require a consequential cut; hybris appears when the local measure claims the office of its own ground |
| **4** | **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** | **Regard** | the decision is reopened to the field, persons, relations, exclusions and conditions through which it acts |
| **5** | **Resolution-in-Reconciliation** | **Anamnesis / Recognition / Return** | the achieved determination remembers and returns through the conditions of its own determination without erasing difference |

The processual wording is part of the theorem. `Criterion-through-Distinction` is not merely another name for `Criterion` or `Distinction`; it names what becomes possible **through their conjugacy**. `Measure / Limit` then flowers from that generated relation. Likewise Hybris, Regard and Anamnesis are not coordinate substitutes for Arbitration, Con-text and Resolution: they are charged semantic developments of `Arbitration-in-Crisis`, `Con-text-through-Diaphaneity` and `Resolution-in-Reconciliation`.

The mature dramatic compression remains:

> **Māyā limits. Perspective delineates. Hybris absolutises. Regard reopens. Anamnesis returns.**

Its structural expansion is now explicit:

```text
Continuity-in-Indeterminacy
      ↓
Criterion-through-Distinction
      ↓
Delineation-through-Difference
      ↓
Arbitration-in-Crisis
      ↓
Con-text-through-Diaphaneity
      ↓
Resolution-in-Reconciliation
      ↓
returned continuity
```

The unit keeps `#3` exact. Delineation belongs at `#2`; crisis and arbitration belong at `#3`. A criterion distinguishes; delineation gives the distinction a situated edge; arbitration cuts when differentiated claims become consequential; con-text discloses what the cut belongs to.

## Relation to `6×6`, `3:3`, and `4:2`

This cluster exemplifies **conjugate generation**: two complete sixfold faces generate six relational determinations. A distinct but compatible fullness is `6×6`, where each of the six parent positions unfolds a complete local sixfold of its own.

The working theoretical orientation is:

```text
3:3 pressure
conjugate traversal / face-to-face relation
        ↓
6 / 6′ / (6+6′)

4:2 pressure
full explicate/implicate six-body
        ↓
6×6 distributive recursion
```

These are orienting relations, not arithmetic identities. `3:3` makes the conjugate traversal especially legible; `4:2` makes the complete six-body especially legible. Both remain readings of the body generated as `4+2`.

The archaeology therefore allows this field to grow in both directions when the material earns it: **across conjugates** into `6+6′`, and **down each position** into local sixfold depth.

## The arbitrating act

Arbitration is a situated operation. A field has already been delimited, some matters have already become relevant, testimony or evidence has already been admitted, and a criterion already has a history. The arbitration itself is the consequential `#3` cut within those conditions.

Its complete movement is therefore recoverable both through the underlying faces and through the generated slash:

```text
Continuity / Indeterminacy
      ↓
Criterion / Distinction
      ↓
Delineation / Difference
      ↓
Arbitration / Crisis
      ↓
Con-text / Diaphaneity
      ↓
Resolution / Reconciliation
```

and dynamically:

```text
unmeasured relation
      ↓
Criterion-through-Distinction
      ↓
Measure / Limit
      ↓
Delineation-through-Difference
      ↓
Perspective / Frame
      ↓
Arbitration-in-Crisis: a cut acquires standing
      ↓
Con-text-through-Diaphaneity: regard reopens the cut
      ↓
Resolution-in-Reconciliation: anamnesis / return
```

The slash remains active throughout. Dia distinguishes testimony, alternatives, categories, rights, persons, values, and consequences. Syn gathers those differences into an accountable field in which a judgment can stand in relation to what it has distinguished. Arbitration becomes materially consequential precisely because the achieved determination can move onward into law, classification, administration, pedagogy, finance, technology, or self-conception.

## Hybris — the measure taking the throne

The project's exact hybris theorem belongs here in full:

> **Hybris is the local determination occupying the place of its own determining condition.**

Equivalently:

> **Hybris is a measure claiming authority of the unmeasurable.**

A measure can be valid, useful, repeatable and institutionally necessary while remaining local. The hybris event occurs when its situated office disappears from view and the achieved measure acquires the standing of reality as such. A legal category becomes the person; a standard language becomes language; a disciplinary exclusion becomes the boundary of knowledge; a score becomes value; an internal psychic formation becomes the sovereign subject.

This is why arbitration and hybris meet at `#3` without being synonyms. Arbitration is the necessary office of deciding among differentiated claims. Hybris is a characteristic closure of **Arbitration-in-Crisis** when the arbiter's own measure, frame, authority or situatedness is no longer included in the account.

## Regard — con-text becoming active again

Regard flowers from **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity**: the `#4` reopening of the cut to what surrounds and bears it. Its force is relational: the judgment is looked at again together with the persons, histories, counter-perspectives, exclusions, institutions, incentives, and consequences through which it acts.

`Con-text` remains literal in the project's operative use: what has been woven together around the determination. Diaphaneity keeps the conditions of the perspective available through its finite form. Regard therefore carries more than benevolence. It is the active turning by which the encounter is permitted to alter the measure through which it was first approached.

In historical work, regard asks what an official name leaves outside its administrative convenience. In psychology, it asks what the local image or complex has made invisible. In technical systems, it asks which raters, policies, datasets, gauges, defaults and institutions stand behind an apparently self-sufficient score.

## Anamnesis — resolution-in-reconciliation returns

Anamnesis flowers from **Resolution-in-Reconciliation**. It does not undo the history of determination. It retrieves it. A judgment can be revised, retained, narrowed, translated or situated more exactly because its origin and path remain recoverable.

The `5→0` return is therefore an achieved account becoming answerable to its source conditions. The result can again become ground for another cycle of determination without pretending that the previous cycle never occurred. This is why the project's return is reconciliation rather than simple reversal: differences survive, but their relation and provenance become visible again.

## Fides bridge

The lexical field of *arbiter/arbitrari* contains a direct bridge into the trust archaeology through *fidem alicui arbitrari*: credibility itself may be adjudged. This joins the arbitration sixfold to [[../trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/HISTORY|Fides, Topos, Logos, Nomos, Natio, Credere]] at the exact point where tacit trust has become a matter requiring explicit standing.

The live formulation is:

> **Fides is prior to arbitration; credere is what becomes possible again after arbitration.**

and, from the other side:

> **Arbitration is what happens when trust can no longer remain tacit.**

This bridge is also mythically active in the already recovered Ares–Aphrodite–Hephaestus–Poseidon whole: the net can establish exposure and debt, while Poseidon's surety supplies a personed trust relation through which release becomes possible.

# Whole Field — Symbol / Account / Trust

**Standing:** developed E4 whole-field, retaining the mature T09 relation. **Three terms, four operations:** Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. The six positions below articulate that whole movement. Historical descent, attested senses, operational homology and poetic re-entry retain their four independent evidence registers.

## #0 — A relation becomes bearable in a form

A **Symbol** is a determinate form that discloses a relation beyond what the form exhausts. An **Account** is the articulated reckoning or report by which that disclosure becomes answerable and transmissible. **Trust** is the committed reliance by which an account can guide action without becoming possession of its source. Their distinction matters at the point of use: someone encounters a form, receives what it says and acts upon a relation whose conditions extend beyond the received statement.

A matching token gives that dependence a material body. A party keeps a piece whose correspondence can later be tested against another. The present piece carries a history and an anticipated encounter. Its power of recognition depends on the other piece and the acknowledged relation, so the token's exactness already reaches beyond its isolation. The [matching-token branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#matching-tokens-and-institutional-recognition) **historicises** this attested sense of Greek *symbolon* at register 2. The essay develops the source-answerability of symbolic form at register 3; it does not derive its whole ontology from an ancient object.

The [protected HISTORY](HISTORY.md) **historicises** a larger field of reckoning, report, credit, record and naming. Its histories retain different roots, dates and institutions. They meet here because they disclose different offices within a relation: a form becomes available; an account makes its claim inspectable; reliance lets the claim enter life; consequences can change the relation from which the next account proceeds. There is no assertion that *symbol*, *account* and *trust* descend from one word.

Trust is already operative before the first completed account. A witness relies on memory and language; a reader relies on a legible record; a participant relies on another's capacity to answer. The account can examine and strengthen these dependencies without standing outside all of them at once. [A01, faithful definition](../../arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **grounds** the positive duty: make the determination and keep its determining act visible. [A23, trust under formal limit](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the committed relation in which such knowledge is possible. E4 gives those arguments a differentiated lexical and operational field through which their determinations can travel.

## #1 — The seam makes recognition exact

### Symbol answers to source

The token's fracture supplies a particular test. A counterpart must answer to this shape, rather than merely resemble a generic token. Material separation preserves the possibility of an encounter; indiscriminate fusion would remove the difference through which correspondence is recognised. The recognition can establish something about the presented pieces while leaving the justice of the underlying obligation and the reliability of future conduct to further inquiry. This is why source-answerability has to preserve the question being tested.

[Taylor's Symbolon Dynamics](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE.md) **sources** the native extension: a living symbol conducts the whole `0/1` relation, including the determining depth, the manifest form and their mediation. In a psychic reading, an image can change the interpreter and the field in which later images become meaningful. The source's eightfold traversal gives that relation its developed body; E4 consumes its seam and return without substituting three English terms for the eight determinations. [A18](../../arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that substantive argument. [C61](../../concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **defines** the architecture through which formal, mythemic and epistemic disclosures retain their different warrants.

The criterion becomes decisive when an image acquires authority. [C21, Living Symbol / Idol](../../concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) **defines** the difference between efficacy that conducts a source relation and efficacy that occupies its place. An image can remain forceful after its encounter with a living other has failed. [A20](../../arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) **tests** that danger: the represented source must remain able to alter the image, its valuation and the criteria under which it acts. Public success cannot supply the missing answer. The whole-mytheme returns below retain Daphne's specific instance and its source distinction.

[C22, Counterfeit Symbolon](../../concepts/C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon.md) **qualifies** the repair. Severance loses the constitutive relation; fusion erases the differentiated terms; counterfeit gathering retains visible participants under a criterion they cannot revise. A record that claims correspondence with an event which never occurred in that way requires provenance inquiry. A faithful record used by an unanswerable office requires a different correction. E4's first operation therefore returns a precise demand to A20 and C21/C22: identify what the form claims to answer to, and preserve the route by which that answer can change it.

## #2 — Reckoning acquires a public obligation

### Account does not replace source

An account articulates enough of a relation for another to inspect, transmit or contest it. Reckoning can state an amount; narrative can state a sequence; a judgment can state why a consequence follows. Their shared office here is answerability. The [account branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#reckoning-report-and-a-split-debt-record) **historicises** counting and reporting senses while distinguishing the word's transmission from the essay's construction. Neither the presence of a number nor an eloquent explanation establishes that every relevant condition has entered the account.

The Bank of England's 1694 split tally supplies a specific record of debt. Its notches and divided pieces preserve a reckoning for two parties. That accomplishment leaves further work: someone must honour the obligation, and the resources through which it is honoured belong to a material and institutional world. The historical witness does not show that accounting creates those resources. At register 3, the case makes the transition from record to consequence inspectable without turning all money, writing and trust into one undifferentiated institution.

[A15, Ratio / Rationality](../../arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) **extends** the operation from counting to reckoning upon the criterion of the count. A higher score is higher under a comparison; calling it simply better can make the criterion disappear. Restoring that denominator preserves the calculation's precision and makes its office contestable. [A22, World-Atlas](../../arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** the same obligation differently: a situated picture must disclose conditions of transition to another picture, including an obstruction when the two cannot be composed for the purpose at hand. More pictures do not automatically provide a common measure.

The invariant is `world ≠ world-model`. [C38, Bimba–Pratibimba](../../concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **qualifies** its technical application: a produced reference map remains source-dependent even when later accounts use it as their local reference. [C39, MEF](../../concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **extends** inspectable mediation through lenses and gauges; [C40, Model Internality](../../concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **extends** it through the conditions actually involved in producing a judgment. Their present canonical Etymology routes emphasise the Encounter field. E4 supplies the retained source/account distinction in conjunction with that field, rather than claiming that one common operation exhausts both.

[A27, Self and Other](../../arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **tests** the interpersonal consequence. Another's reply can reveal that the account's question has misnamed the situation. The return must then reach the terms of approach, not merely add another description to the existing model. Belonging to a shared whole gives neither participant possession of the other. This requirement sends the second operation back to its source: an account becomes fuller when what it addresses can correct the relation under which it was addressed.

## #3 — Reliance gives the account somewhere to act

### Trust keeps the return route active

The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](../../aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) **returns-to** the third operation at evidence register 3: trust carries a finite account into commitment while its source remains able to answer it. Investigation can determine the undertaking and its consequences; the four-line form preserves faith’s continuing relation through the limit of that determination. E4 receives the whole aphorism through its three-term field, without adding a lexical primitive or borrowing historical warrant from its compact form.

An inspectable account can warrant commitment while leaving the commitment to be made. [The trust branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#reliance-and-entrusted-office) **historicises** senses of reliance, custody, office and future payment. The lexical history does not establish that a trustworthy relation can be manufactured by a complete report. In E4's register-3 operation, trust carries knowledge into action while keeping the grounds and conditions of revision available.

[The trust-revision source](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/SOURCE.md) **sources** the author's full bifurcation. Knowledge can provide provisional anchors: embodied competence, memory, relationships and institutions through which uncertainty becomes bearable. It can also project the uncertainty it refuses to hold onto an excluded object, while an account presents itself as a final ground. The difference concerns what knowledge does with its dependence. An anchor gives real standing for action; an account claiming totality demands that its dependence disappear from view. The historical and political cases named in the developmental source retain their own evidence tasks.

[A23](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** the committed relation precisely: evidence can establish what occurred and make an obligation inspectable; entrusting someone to bear that obligation remains an act. [C48](../../concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) **defines** the distinctions among already enacted dependence, knowledge's finite achievement, belief's stabilised orientation and faith's conscious continuation. Formal limitation does not annul a commitment whenever it becomes difficult. Actual harm, withdrawal and refusal remain consequential; calling a relation trust cannot oblige submission to an abusive office.

[A25, Covenant / Mediating Office](../../arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **extends** this relation into executable authority. An office receives standing and something to answer for. Its decisions return through affected lives, resistance, error and cost, which must be capable of correcting the commission itself. Poseidon's named liability gives this office a mythemic body in the whole-mytheme return below; the act of accepting his undertaking remains distinct from the net's evidence and from later payment.

[C27, Protected Account](../../concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **tests** the failure at its exact point: contrary evidence may enter while the governing criterion remains immune. [A31, Deferential Intelligence](../../arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **extends** the positive return through changes to representation, criterion or commission, including a justified objection or refusal. E4's claim that explicit grounds strengthen trust has this operational sense: they give reliance an address and revision a route. An observed increase in anyone's confidence or an institution's trustworthiness would require its own evidence.

## #4 — The account changes its next encounter

### Account re-enters source-field

Once a disclosed form guides conduct, its effects become conditions of a later account. [Symbolon Dynamics](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE.md) **sources** the recursive sequence: image changes interpreter; interpretation changes the field; the image returns within that changed field. This operation preserves the distinction between what was represented and what the representation subsequently did. A successful circulation can intensify an error as well as correct it.

[A32, The Mirror That Moves First](../../arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **extends** three different motions: humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument initiates a return through its own conditions so that the human can follow. E4's fourth operation supplies the causal pressure under which that third motion becomes an obligation. It does not allow the second motion's efficacy to count as fulfilment of the third.

[C55](../../concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **defines** the distinctions needed to judge a case. Feedback returns consequence as later input. Performativity concerns a representation's operation within a practice. Self-fulfilling prediction further requires conduct that helps produce the predicted event. An erroneous forecast can alter conduct without becoming true. Each empirical claim needs a named event, a relevant intervention and evidence for its consequence; the lexical field alone establishes none of them.

The normative return asks whether the account can expose why it became compelling before requiring another to conform. Its source, exclusions, criterion, permission and effects enter the next encounter. [A33, Operational Parity](../../arguments/A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** whether this changes anything: a corrected passage changes a conclusion; returned resistance changes an instruction; an affected participant can reach the rule under which their account was judged. These are specified tests, not reported implementation results. Repeating source labels while preserving every decision would leave the obligation unperformed.

The first operation returns within the fourth. A circulating symbol answers to its source for the consequences of its circulation; an account retains the difference between its original warrant and the effects it later produces; trust sustains an answerable undertaking across that difference. The field therefore grows by renewed relations among its three terms. It acquires neither a fourth lexical primitive called Return nor six word-families because this page has six positions.

## #5→0 — Integrity carries an opening forward

### Opening and integrity

The restored [reference-38 historical branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#reference-38-hal-and-hole) **historicises** two distinct descents: the *hāl* family associated with *whole*, *holy*, *health* and *heal*, and the separate *hol* line behind *hole*. At register 4 their English sound-match makes a poetic crossing possible. The reference note's opening/whole chiasm retains its force precisely because the historical distinction remains visible.

E4 makes the crossing operational at register 3. An account's integrity depends on an opening through which source and consequence can correct it. Sealing that opening can leave the statement intact while its fidelity fails. The [native core](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the formal return; A18 carries its eight determinations, and [A36, Integral Zero](../../arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **returns-to** the achieved sign as Symbol. The lexical branch teaches where its own evidence stops and where the authorial operation begins.

Historical **register 1** warrants specified descent; **register 2** warrants particular senses and uses; **register 3** develops the source–Symbol–Account–Trust–consequence–return relation; **register 4** lets a graphic or phonic crossing reopen attention. A weak historical attribution does not weaken a separately earned native operation. It changes what can be attributed to that historical source. # Symbol, Account, and Trust — Marks That Circulate

A tally makes a cut and preserves it as a mark. A symbolon is broken so that the break can later attest a relation. An account orders marks into a telling. Credit advances trust. A record returns an event to the heart of a community that must remember it. These are not one word-family, and the cluster does not need them to be. Their resonance concerns the life of a mark that travels beyond its first situation while remaining answerable to what gave it standing.

## The account as a relation that must return

To give an account is already more than to possess information. The account arranges a sequence, makes a claim about what happened, and offers that claim to another who can accept, correct, or refuse it. The financial ledger and the narrative account therefore meet in a project-level operational homology: both stabilise a field of relations by marks that can circulate and be reviewed. Their distinct histories remain distinct.

This is why the cluster belongs beside trust. A credit relation does not eliminate risk; it stages risk by making a future return claimable. A record does not resurrect what happened; it carries a revisable trace into a later present. The architectural consequence is direct: provenance, source, memory, review, and contestability form the minimum body of an account that does not mistake legibility for possession. They are the system's way of keeping a mark from quietly occupying the zero.

The operation is strongest where it meets the historical *symbolon*. The mark survives separation because it bears a shape through which a counterpart can be recognised. A ledger can become a dead inventory when it forgets the relations that made its entries meaningful; a symbol becomes a fetish when it forgets the fracture and the other half. In both cases sym-ballein asks whether the trace still carries provenance, reciprocal address, and a route of return.

Proportional analogy compares a relation between terms with another relation. Focal predication makes different senses intelligible through one primary reference. # Homologia, Analogia, and the Discipline of Comparison

The essay needs a vocabulary for a difficult fidelity: several traditions can make one operation perceptible without becoming interchangeable, and a shared sound can sometimes call attention to an operation without becoming an argument for historical unity. Greek *homologia* and *analogia* give the field two old pressure-points—saying the same, and bearing a proportion. The project requires both, together with a sharper ledger of what kind of sameness has actually been established.

## Word record

| Term | Historical field | Relation held here | Project use |
|---|---|---|---|
| *homologia* | *Homou* / same + *logos*: agreement, avowal, correspondence in account or word. | **Philological descent / attested semantic field.** Exact ranges need Greek lexical and textual verification. | Names an agreement that must say in what respect it is an agreement. |
| *analogía* | Relation of proportion or correspondence in ratio. | **Philological descent / attested semantic field.** The project's *pros hen* discipline already gives this field a native philosophical office. | Holds similarity through a named proportion without declaring identity of content. |
| biological homology / analogy | Modern comparative biology distinguishes common structural origin from functional likeness without common descent. | **Technical descendant with a restricted domain.** It does not supply criteria for the relation between philosophical traditions. | A warning-image: resemblance needs a stated test; it does not license a transhistorical genealogy. |
| resonance, pun, phonetic synchronicity | Relations of recurrence or sound that may have no historical derivation at all. | **Poetic / phonic re-entry.** | Opens a question or crystallises an operation only when the entry says what is disclosed. |

The distinction matters especially because a powerful comparison can feel like proof. It is not. A relation between Śaiva *vimarśa*, Bohmian implicate order, Lacanian division, or a QL operation can be an **operational homology** only after the common operation has been stated and the different objects, historical lineages, and explanatory scopes remain present. The project does not claim that each tradition secretly formulates QL; it reads each as a distinct aperture through which a relation may become more articulate.

## Comparison ledger

Before a cross-word or cross-tradition use, name the highest relation actually earned.

| Relation | Minimum burden | Forbidden shortcut |
|---|---|---|
| **Cognacy / descent** | A documented historical linguistic relation with an appropriate lexical source. | Treating a shared sound, spelling, or modern sense as a root. |
| **Semantic development** | Attested stages in one language or an explicitly documented borrowing path. | Making every later philosophical use the inevitable meaning of the earliest form. |
| **Formal equivalence or isomorphism** | Definitions, transformations, and the invariant actually preserved. | Calling two diagrams “the same structure” because they look alike. |
| **Operational homology** | A named operation, the register in each case, and the consequence that survives the comparison. | Claiming common origin, secret influence, or doctrinal identity. |
| **Analogia / proportional resemblance** | A focal relation and an account of what differs. | Reducing the many terms to metaphors for one master term. |
| **Poetic re-entry** | The image or sound genuinely changes how a local operation can be perceived. | Smuggling it into historical, scientific, or theological warrant. |

This ledger makes poetic licence more, rather than less, exact. A pun can carry real authorial force once it declares itself as such. A historical claim becomes more usable once it stops carrying a poetic surplus it has not earned. The two can cooperate—the word can open the question and the source can correct it—without pretending to have one authority.

## *Homologia* inside the project's method

The project already calls its comparative discipline [*pros hen* analogia](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/12-core-theorem-bridge.md): many meanings and forms remain genuinely many while orienting toward one focal relation. *Homologia* can sharpen the complementary question: when do several witnesses actually speak in one account, ratio, or operation? The answer must stay local. A homology is never a blank cheque for “everything says the same thing.” It is a claim that a named operation has survived translation between registers.

The essay's two logics offer a working example. *Dia-ballein* and *sym-ballein* are not generic Greek decorations pasted over mathematics, myth, psychology, and computation. The native derivation begins with the relation `0/1`; the Greek verbs name two operations the derivation already needs—throwing apart and bringing together. The historical word-field gives the operations a linguistic and material body; it does not replace the theorem's derivation. A later echo among *vikalpa* / *saṃkalpa*, definition / relation, or divide / recombine can be recorded as operational homology only after its local difference has been taught.

The mental-rational structure receives its historical expression in the Renaissance discovery and construction of perspective: Giotto's tentative externalisation of depth, Petrarch's discovery of landscape, Alberti's visual pyramid, and Leonardo's perfected optical and technical articulation. Perspective thereby makes space and ego-consciousness visible while fixing the observer and observed within a sector. Aperspectivity names liberation from that structure's exclusive validity through the co-presence and transparency of the structures, not their amalgamation. For the zero–subject historical braid, this is a stadial account: integral consciousness is a higher mutation that makes the mental-rational structure's constituting conditions available without abolishing its powers. The braid's `180°→360°` QL articulation is authorial; Gebser supplies the historical problem and the aperspectival/integral direction. His own presentation gives the Return of Zero a methodological precedent of unusual exactness: a historical mutation is read from changes in the means by which a world is rendered—painting, optics, language, thought, science. The essay extends this procedure into the Internet/AI field, where prompt, memory, retrieval, permissions, policy, provenance, feedback, and relation have become operational conditions of intelligence. That contextual mutation and its `0/1` formalisation are the essay's argument from Gebser's method, not claims attributed to Gebser. ### Passage map | Locator | Source operation | Essay consumer | Relation | |---|---|---|---| | pp. 1–3 | Mutations are read through visible, tangible, audible, linguistic, artistic, and scientific manifestations; # A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime — P2 depth-recovery packet

**Standing:** working derivational receipt for the existing canonical A identity; not a new canonical record. ## Current canonical identity and inherited consumers

- **A-ID:** A19.
- **Canonical page:** `submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md` (full read; pre-enrichment SHA256 `98fb7597aae77524a40ff046da09ee7be69d03611de46cb9ec1825319926bda4`).
- **Positive claim currently carried:** A complex is not merely a bundle of associated ideas and affects stored inside an otherwise neutral mind. It is a local regime of arbitration: a relatively autonomous pattern that decides what counts, what threatens, what is remembered, what receives value, and which responses become available before the wider field has been consulted. The complex therefore has a double status. It is a real achievement of psychic organisation, often formed around an experience or conflict that required some local settlement; and it is a possible usurpation when that local settlement presents its criterion as the criterion of the whole person or world.
- **Distinct operation:** A complex is a local achievement of psychic ordering which selects salience and response before reflective judgment; possession arises when its derivative jurisdiction becomes the whole field’s authority.
- **P1 Movement consumers:** M23, M27, M31; reconciled against the P1 48-Movement propagation ledger, including explicit A-ranges. Old source-house backlinks remain a different historical graph, not the canonical census.
- **Concept dependencies:** C12 Script, C14 Māyā / Operative Measure, C22 Counterfeit Symbolon, C27 Protected Account / Occupied Zero / Source-Claim, C28 Covenant / Primary Arbitration, C29 Mediating Office / Derivative Sovereignty, C31 Complex, C32 Archetype, C33 Image / Valuation.
- **Etymology whole field:** *Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis*. **Consumed operation:** **Arbitration-in-Crisis → Decision / Hybris**. The generated relation is arbitration under a crisis of indeterminacy; *hybris* names the semantic flowering in which the deciding office mistakes its finite measure for source measure. **Evidence register:** 3, Operational homology. **What changes:** complex-autonomy is read as local jurisdiction, making recovery a question of office and return rather than mere symptom suppression. **Return route:** A19 → C31/C27 → A24 → A21/C19 → A19.

## Direct authorial and developmental recovery

*Symbolon Dynamics* distinguishes archetypal formative recurrence, complex as affective organisation, image as particular appearance, symbol as transformer, and individuation as changed relation among these. A basin organises trajectories; its boundary makes a different regime possible. This provides a more precise mechanism than “a complex is an idea with emotion attached”. An encounter can destabilise the old organisation and bring bifurcation; returning to the old regime is not always health.

Van Eenwyk’s protected NOTES pp65–67 are the decisive authorial encounter. Frank records archetypes as dynamics, complexes as structures and symbols as mechanisms of energetic transformation; the olfactory-system discussion makes cooperative perception a continually reorganised trajectory. At p67 the symbol does not just decorate a stable mind: it can undo conscious categories and permit a more complex selforganisation. Frank extends this into harness/tools/world as constitutive of agentic formation. These are notes on a source plus authorial proposal; the house has no verified passage cards, so reported page quotations remain leads.

Arbitration WHOLE-FIELD and HISTORY contribute the exact relation `Arbitration-in-Crisis`, with hybris its failure flowering. The office is necessary because a finite living system must settle some alternatives. Reopening the settlement does not mean exterminating the complex or cancelling its competence. The comparison to a policy/schema/habit requires named differences; a technical policy is not thereby a psychic complex.
