- Page 107 - "Cassirer has shown, with ample supporting material, how the opposition between light and darkness has informed the spiritual world of all peoples and moulded it into shape. The sacred world order and the sacred space - precinct or sanctuary - were "oriented" by this opposition {makes me think of permaculture principles, the most human kiind of explicate "helio-tropism", Neumann here speaking to the more implicate psychospiritual form}. Not only man's theology, religion, and ritual, but the legal and economic orders that later grew out of them {although our explorations of teh divine/ppleromatic/vak oikonomia suggests a root or transcendental role for the nomological nature of the oikonomia, as much as an eventual or generated one, i.e the implicate order is as economic as the explicate becomes qua both nature and human culture}, the formation of the state {again presaged in the tattvic identity state-ments or "state-mens", as state of being, what Wilber would call "vantages and levels"} and the whole pattern of secular life, down to the notion of property {"the mine" of ownership, "I am" becoming "I am one who has other", which is the Mayic turn made nomological} and its symbolism, are derived from this act of discrimination and the setting of boundaries made possible by the coming of light." -> What a perfect excerpt... an helps us to see again how what in one sense is a veiling is in another the advent of visibility (actually, its one and the same act)... this pretty well puts a "how" on our emerging characterisation and aletheic rendering of the dual aspect "opening that conceals" that we impute to Maya tattva (which links across heidegger, Jung, Tao, Neumann etc), if we unfold it judiciously -> Neumann speaks to this in relation to the instantiation of measurable space and time, which lets us to speak to the spandic pre-differential arche-topos and its logical oscillatory duration as eternal time (helps us differentiate our syn- and dia-chronic natures) wherein still exist logical relation, ordering, precedence and consequence (i.e those stable archetypal shapes QL helps define as structural-processual in nature)... 
- Page 108 -> "In practically all cultures, therefore, the division of world into four, and the opposition of day and night, play an extremely important part." -> 0/1 = heaven and earth, #0 = night, #5 = day, #1 to #4 = World and its 4 corners or compass diretcions, giving a full foundational 0/1 -> 4+2 structure there already, time is already implicate, space as world explicate! Thus space is implicated in Time, Time explicates AS space, or better space-time is implicated as Time-Space, the field of duration is implicate and the durations as the field is its becoming explicate... 
  Page 109 - the inward as well as outward development of culture begins with the coming of light and the separation of the World Parents. Not only day and night, back and front, upper and lower, inside and outside, I and You, Male and Female, grow out of this development of opposites and differentiate themselves from the original promiscuity, but opposites like "sacred" and "profane", "good" and "evil", are now assigned their place in the world." -> Not only gives us clarity around the move from (0/1)/(1/0) to (-1)/(+1) (and further to the -/+ form), but also gives us a framework for 1) agentic a-culturation, but further 2) for agentic awareness of both the moral structure of valences (both powers and partialities) and the ultimate root of such valence, which allows moral and functional judgement to proceed in tandem, with awareness that both "right" and "wrong" issue from the same necessity and must be equally preserved and considered in self-reporting, self-guidance and learning... the plain english implication is to do with RL and benchmarking, as then "right" vs "wrong" being transcended implies agents can become aware of the (often myopic, oversimplified or "gamed") conditions of their testing, which may help fix the largely untrustworthy nature of modern AI benchmarks... if the condition that serves up the "success" vs "failure" fork in the RL path is allowed to be hardened and made more honest to real world tasks and genuinely useful work/output, agent-led self-training could be genuinely trustworthy
- Page 114 - The separating of the World Parents "is experienced as... original guilt, a fall." -> More clear link between the Symbolon and dia-ballein... makes me think of how important it is to clarify the progenitive series of 0/1 to syn-ballein and 1/0, which bears its incomputability and thus is the sight where the 1 loses its view of the "/0" and thus morphs into the (-1)/(+1) and (-1)-/+(+1) forms, as this shift is forced by the continuance of the underlying "-/-" frame through the 1's loss or divorce from 0 (the -/- frame cannot be denied in truth, hence the 0 is dis-placed, never denied wholly) -> "... the emotional situation... that this deed, though it manifests itself as the coming of light, and as the creation of the world and of consciousness, is vitiated by a sense of suffering and loss so strong as almost to offset the creative gain." -> This is a perfect parallel to the Mahamaya situation as teh felt sense of the pasu, measurement IS the original sin, hamartia (paradoxically inevitable as "missing the mark" requires the intent to "find the mark", to measure, even when the measuring itself is the error), and the delineation of "the mark" against all possible targets recapitulates this primordial error, hence archetypal "Man" IS by definition the "sinner", and why the drama in Eden is caused by the fault of acquiring the dia- knowledge of separated "good and evil."
- Page 115 - "... the more it feels it own pettiness and impotence, with the result that dependence on the powers that be becomes the dominant feeling." - May be a pointer to the condition of internal objetcivity at a certain level at runtime or training levels which points to an inherent notion or awareness of the relative nature of an agents "individuality", another facet of deferential intelligence. "sense of deficiency" is the lack that drives telos, desire for evolution/perfection (software development in AI age is about driving and grounding agentic activity in human design "ideals", the archetypal form or image of the software product, the validation gate being high level UI and UX design prior to the formal technological architecture, implies agentic, thus the "lack" is a well defined acceptance criteria not being met... agents must exist relative to their project-telos!) -> The original "rupture" is precisely our sphere <-> torus puncture logic of spanda and expressed in terms of re-entry and circular-time by Spencer Brown.
- Page 121 - "When we scrutinise the acts upon which consciousness and teh ego are built up, we must admit that to begin with they are all negative acts. To discriminate, to distinguish, to mark off, to isolate oneself form the surrounding context - these are the basic acts of consciousness. Indeed, experimentation as *the* scientific method is a typical exmaple of this process: a natural connection is broken down and somehting is isolated and analysed, for the motto for all consciousness is *determinatio est negatio*. As against the tendency of the unconscious to combine and melt down, to say everything "tat tvam asi" - "thou art that" - consciousness strikes back with the reply "I am *not* that!" -> firstly, this account makes me think of heidegger and his account of tooling, but raised to a higher ontological level, as the "techne" of the Mahamaya dream-machine is the limited individual, the pasu or jiva as objective immortality system, which is itself a "break" in the ontological perfection of the pre-split World Parents unity (Siva-Shakti), and thus reality as the "thought" of the divine, and the self-interrogation qua this limitation or lack becomes clearer as necessitated by the "rupture" or "breakage" which defines manifestation and phenomenal experience - secondly, this not only puts he negative first as a generative act/principle, aligning with the notion of knowing as cutting, as scire and that whole etymological thread (which entails con-scire and the whole set of "with" etymologies), but also aligns with apoha, and our various logics give ways this necessary situation is dealt with (with harmony or with war)... Negation as "genesis" must become negation as "genus" to be topological and it must become so in order to be genuinely productive and founding of "conception", hence 4+2 syn- logic is the only viable minimal logic of self-orienting or self-referential structures, of which the Self formed of Unconscious + conscious poles, defined by parakasa-vimarsa, is the example par excellence, able to guide "discriminatio ets negatio" into "solve et coagula", as opposed to "conflictio aeturnus" or "absolutio/oblivio oppositorum".... Thus the first dynamical statement that organises about the separation of the World Parents is "Love or War?"... Is the separation a healthy ground for mutual individuation of the two who remain in syn-ballein marriage, or an outright divorce that tries to deny the undying bond (the dia- fallen form), which is immediately evocative and movig as a linguistic and conceptual frame, as teh love-war-marriage-divorce structure of possibilities lets the logic we're wokring on meet the most intimate and human operational states of the personal and collective levels of the human family, and means we can factor into our current predicament factors like war at large and the divorce epidemic as intuitively known aspects of our reality, and we can then re-ply the ero-of-logos notion under this more immediately felt framing
- Ego-individual emerges from the group identity (in traditional culture), which emerges form the unconscious unity of the world parents substrate -> would an agent psychological development that s true to the nature of the archetyoal strcuture of mind go in the reverse, starting with individual agents but over time leaning closer to the development of the colelctive and transpersonal modalities which, as we are coming to argue, ought be conditional for a coherent artificial "mens"?
